summary: The proof correctly derives that every strict-low-mass middle-slice cover has three members, normalizes an inclusion-minimal cover via a valid affine Farkas certificate, obtains the slope-sum alternative and fixes its sign by height reflection, and then proves the strict endpoint-area ordering from the resulting slice cover and the accepted Brunn-Minkowski area inequality. All cited predecessor hypotheses apply, and the strict inequalities, boundary conventions, and reflection effects are handled correctly.
